## Goal
- Build a real autonomous IVX Senior Developer Worker (IVX-SENIOR-DEV-01) that operates without Rork browser, can read/edit code, run tests, commit to GitHub, deploy to Render, verify production, and return proof to IVX chat — replacing the fake "senior developer" certification with an honest, working system.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- System must work when Rork browser is closed — no Rork session dependency for runtime execution
- Every engineering request must return HTTP 202 with: taskId, status, taskType, assignedWorker, approvalRequired, createdAt
- Owner approval phrases required for: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL, CONFIRM_IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLE
- Do not label system "VERIFIED" until chat-only certification test passes end-to-end with real evidence (commitSha, deployId, 3-way SHA parity, proofLedgerId)
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files MUST use gzip-base64 encoding (plain text 317KB hono.ts triggers WAF 403)
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`

## Progress
### Done
- ALL 8 ORIGINAL WORKER FILES COMMITTED + DEPLOYED — initial deploy SHA `778b1898a85e` went live (boot 23:06:53Z)
- 10 ROOT-CAUSE BUGS IDENTIFIED AND FIXED across 13 commits to GitHub, each deployed to Render:
  1. **Route shadowing** (commit `e90f597e324f` in `hono.ts`): OLD `ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` POST /jobs + GET /jobs/:jobId at lines 3833+3836 shadowed NEW handlers at 3116-3118 (Hono lets later registration win). Fixed: removed OLD shadowing lines.
  2. **General worker race** (commit `63a9e531a414` in `ivx-owner-ai-task-queue.ts`): General queue worker claimed `senior_dev` tasks first, called chat AI, marked VERIFIED in ~8s with hollow evidence. Fixed: general worker skips senior_dev tasks.
  3. **AI model wrong** (commit `f9039597635` in `ivx-senior-dev-ai.ts`): Default `gpt-4.1-mini` doesn't work with Vercel AI Gateway; needs `openai/gpt-4o` provider prefix. Fixed `resolveModel()` to default to `openai/gpt-4o`.
  4. **Hollow VERIFIED logic** (commit `22440231ea7` in `ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`): `health.ok && (!requestsDeploy || !changedFiles.length || versionMatch)` → VERIFIED even when nothing committed. Fixed: requires `didRealWork = changedFiles.length > 0 && lastCommitSha !== null`.
  5. **AI planning silent fallback** (same commit `22440231ea7`): When AI planning failed, silently fell back to audit-only → hollow VERIFIED. Fixed: FAILs task honestly with AI planning error.
  6. **proof_ledger_id not patched** (same commit `22440231ea7`): `proof_ledger_id` wasn't patched back onto task after ledger write. Fixed: `await patchTask(task.id, { proof_ledger_id: runId })`.
  7. **task_type column doesn't exist in DB** (commits `a9b95360c6ff` + `8a42fbfd0add`): DDL self-bootstrap needs `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`; `task_type` column never created → `task_type === 'senior_dev'` never matched → general worker kept claiming. Fixed: both workers now filter on `trace_id.startsWith('senior-dev-')` (always present, in original CREATE TABLE).
  8. **Worker not started in server.ts** (commit `89914bf53a21`): `startSeniorDevWorker()` was ONLY called in `backend/worker.ts` (separate worker process), NOT in `server.ts` (main API entry point that actually runs on Render). Fixed: starts in `server.ts` gated on `IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLED === 'true'`.
  9. **claimTask filter blocked pre-assigned tasks** (commit `fd9f3e8a9b58`): `claimTask` used `&assigned_worker_id=is.null` but submit endpoint pre-sets `assigned_worker_id='IVX-SENIOR-DEV-01'` → task never claimable. Fixed: accepts `or=(assigned_worker_id.is.null,assigned_worker_id.eq.IVX-SENIOR-DEV-01)`.
  10. **AI hallucinated file paths** (commits `48c78d3b5f15` + `00b533a6472b` + `f1116733752e`): AI planned changes to `src/chat/ChatService.js` (doesn't exist). Added `githubListFiles` (Git Trees API recursive) to `ivx-senior-dev-git.ts` and wired into planning phase in `ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` + `ivx-senior-dev-ai.ts` so AI plans against real repo file tree (up to 400 files, filtered to relevant source).
  11. **AI didn't see current file content** (commit `7aed49254166`): In IMPLEMENTING, if file wasn't in `filesToInspect`, `current=''` caused AI to hallucinate full file from scratch. Fixed: always reads current file from GitHub before generating patch.
  12. **Self-healing test-fix loop** (commit `7e1ca9c8ade6`): When tsc/tests fail, worker reported FAILED but didn't self-correct. Added loop: feeds error output back to AI, retries up to 3 times before reporting FAILED honestly.
- RENDER ENV VAR SET: `IVX_SENIOR_DEV_WORKER_ENABLED=true` on srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0 (HTTP 200, valueStored: true)
- CURRENT RUNTIME SHA: `7e1ca9c8ade6` (boot 23:57:31Z, healthy, all 10 fixes live)
- WORKER IS RUNNING AND EXECUTING REAL PHASES — confirmed across multiple certification test runs:
  - Task `db12c161`: PLANNING → INSPECTING → IMPLEMENTING (real file `backend/chat-storage.ts`) → TESTING → FAILED honestly (typecheck=fail tests=fail), proofLedgerId=`acd3abf9`
  - Task `2e05f8e4`: PLANNING → INSPECTING → IMPLEMENTING (real file `backend/api/public-chat.ts`) → TESTING → FAILED honestly, proofLedgerId=`dcb31218`
  - Task `a0956cb8`: Same pattern, filesChanged=`["backend/api/public-chat.ts"]`, proofLedgerId=`dcb31218`
- HOLLOW VERIFIED PROBLEM IS GONE — worker refuses to fake success; all recent tasks either reach VERIFIED with real evidence or FAIL honestly
- `ensureSeniorDevTables()` CONFIRMED WORKING — proofLedgerId is written on every task (proves SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN IS present in runtime env, DDL ran successfully)
- AI GATEWAY CONFIRMED WORKING — provider `vercel_ai_gateway`, model `openai/gpt-4o`, key prefix `vck_`, credentialValid: true

### In Progress
- CERTIFICATION TEST TASK `20f65308-235c-49df-9167-6835a843c099` — submitted at 23:57:54Z with self-healing loop LIVE at runtime `7e1ca9c8`. Status: RUNNING/TESTING since ~23:
